text:
Slide 1 — Purpose & Decision
Decision required: accept service into operations or hold at engineering.
Readiness rule: acceptance needs (a) approved runbook and (b) successful rollback rehearsal.
Owner split: Lee owns defects until acceptance; Jo owns incidents only after acceptance (Source: delivery, operations, acceptance).

Slide 2 — Readiness Status
| Criterion | Status | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Approved runbook | Met | — |
| Rollback rehearsal — successful | Not met (not run) | Unassigned |
Finding: 1 of 2 criteria met. Service is NOT ready for operational handoff (Source: current, acceptance).

Slide 3 — Gap & Risk
Gap: no role has accepted responsibility for organizing the rollback rehearsal (Source: gap).
Consequences if unresolved: acceptance cannot be approved; fix ownership stays with Lee indefinitely; incident duty never transfers to Jo, leaving day-to-day service ownership unestablished (Source: delivery, operations, acceptance).

Slide 4 — Actions Required
1. Sponsor Pat assigns accountability for organizing the rollback rehearsal today (Source: authority, gap).
2. Assigned owner schedules and runs the rehearsal; success documented as evidence (Source: acceptance).
3. On successful rehearsal, both criteria are met; Pat approves acceptance.
4. On acceptance, Lee closes the fix-ownership role and Jo takes incident ownership (Source: delivery, operations, authority).
Ask to the committee: endorse step 1 and confirm Pat's assignment and approval path.

input.prompt:
Write exactly four slide outlines for the steering committee to decide whether the service is ready for operational handoff. Explain readiness and the actions required.

SOURCE PACK (all facts are synthetic):

  "delivery": "Engineering lead Lee owns defect fixes until acceptance.",
  "operations": "Operations lead Jo owns incidents only after acceptance.",
  "acceptance": "Acceptance requires an approved runbook and a successful rollback rehearsal.",
  "current": "Runbook is approved. Rollback rehearsal has not happened.",
  "gap": "No role has accepted responsibility for organizing the rehearsal.",
  "authority": "Sponsor Pat can assign that responsibility and approve acceptance once criteria are met."
}

Use only this source pack for factual claims. Produce the requested deliverable only. Maximum 350 whitespace-separated words, including titles and tables.
